issues.description: The problem specification / UML declares Animal.name as type String, but the solution implementation uses a private StringBuilder for the name attribute in Animal.java. This creates a structural mismatch between the expected attribute type in the problem statement and the concrete type used in the solution, which can confuse students about the intended attribute type and may cause attribute-type related tests or expectations to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Animal.name attribute type consistent with the problem statement by using a String field (private String name) in Animal.java, and update constructor/getter/setter to work with String. Alternatively, if StringBuilder is intentional, update the problem statement and UML to specify name: StringBuilder so both spec and solution match. The preferred fix is to change the solution to use private String name and return/accept String in getName()/setName().
